title: French Pasta Bowl
description: A quick and easy French-inspired pasta dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines cooked pasta, cherry tomatoes, and a simple vinaigrette for a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the French pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil and red wine vinegar for the vinaigrette.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl with the vinaigrette and toss to combine.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
